name: Creature control broker lab test
description: Lab test of kiln.creature_control (19d-creature-control S1-S2): a lease on a forced-ready creature is Pending, then Active with its SteeringAgent gone and its AI off; tick writes of ActorInput move it; a release restores the SteeringAgent (queryId zeroed, then made anew by the game) and the AI; a lease waits for a swing to end; a destroyed body fails its lease. Needs kiln/data/kiln.creatures/force-ready. PASS and FAIL lines in kiln.log.
